_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

data.name: orders_one_open_per_table
data.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX orders_one_open_per_table ON orders (table_id) WHERE status = 'open' AND table_id IS NOT NULL

data.name: shifts_one_open
data.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX shifts_one_open ON shifts (status) WHERE status = 'open'

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "installation" ("singleton" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK("singleton" = 1), "installation_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "receipt_prefix" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_demo" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_demo" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_by_app_version" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("singleton"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sequences" ("name" TEXT NOT NULL, "next_value" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("next_value" > 0), PRIMARY KEY ("name"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "restaurant_settings" ("singleton" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK("singleton" = 1), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "address" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "phone" TEXT NULL, "tax_registration_id" TEXT NULL, "currency_code" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'INR', "time_zone" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Asia/Kolkata', "cutoff_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 240, "receipt_header" TEXT NULL, "receipt_footer" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Thank you! Visit again.', "cashier_discount_limit_bps" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1000, "service_charge_bps" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "service_charge_tax_profile_id" TEXT NULL, "delivery_charge_default" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "delivery_charge_tax_profile_id" TEXT NULL, "rounding_unit" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "lock_timeout_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 5, "kot_show_prices" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("kot_show_prices" IN (0, 1)), "auto_print_receipt" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("auto_print_receipt" IN (0, 1)), "auto_print_kot" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("auto_print_kot" IN (0, 1)), "backup_directory" TEXT NULL, "backup_interval_hours" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 24, "backup_retention" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 14, "last_backup_at" INTEGER NULL, "setup_completed_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, PRIMARY KEY ("singleton"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "staff" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "role" TEXT NOT NULL, "pin_hash" TEXT NOT NULL, "email" TEXT NULL, "password_hash" TEXT NULL, "must_change_password" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("must_change_password" IN (0, 1)), "disabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("disabled" IN (0, 1)), "failed_attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "locked_until" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "owner_recovery" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "code_hash" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "used_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tax_profiles" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "mode" TEXT NOT NULL, "rate_bps" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("rate_bps" BETWEEN 0 AND 10000), "components_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("archived" IN (0, 1)), "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "categories" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("archived" IN (0, 1)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "menu_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "category_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES categories (id), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "price" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("price" >= 0), "tax_profile_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES tax_profiles (id), "available" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("available" IN (0, 1)), "archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("archived" IN (0, 1)), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "sku" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "item_variants" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "item_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES menu_items (id), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "price" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("price" >= 0), "archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("archived" IN (0, 1)), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "item_modifiers" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "item_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES menu_items (id), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "price" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("price" >= 0), "archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("archived" IN (0, 1)), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "dining_tables" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "capacity" INTEGER NULL, "archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("archived" IN (0, 1)), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "orders" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "order_no" INTEGER NOT NULL, "order_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "table_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES dining_tables (id), "table_label" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES staff (id), "created_by_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "business_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "customer_name" TEXT NULL, "guest_count" INTEGER NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "bill_discount_type" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'none', "bill_discount_value" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "discount_reason" TEXT NULL, "discount_approved_by" TEXT NULL, "service_charge_bps" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "service_charge_tax_json" TEXT NULL, "delivery_charge" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "delivery_charge_tax_json" TEXT NULL, "rounding_unit" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "cancelled_at" INTEGER NULL, "cancelled_by" TEXT NULL, "cancel_reason" TEXT NULL, "cancel_business_date" TEXT NULL, "finalized_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "order_lines" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "order_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES orders (id), "item_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES menu_items (id), "category_id" TEXT NULL, "category_name" TEXT NULL, "item_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "variant_id" TEXT NULL, "variant_name" TEXT NULL, "unit_price" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("unit_price" >= 0), "modifiers_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "modifiers_unit_total" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "quantity" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("quantity" >= 0), "note" TEXT NULL, "line_discount_type" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'none', "line_discount_value" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "tax_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "created_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "kitchen_tickets" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "order_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES orders (id), "ticket_no" INTEGER NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "reason" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "operation_id" TEXT NULL UNIQUE, "order_ref" TEXT NOT NULL, "table_label" TEXT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_by_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "kitchen_ticket_lines" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "ticket_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES kitchen_tickets (id), "order_line_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES order_lines (id), "order_line_revision" INTEGER NOT NULL, "item_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "variant_name" TEXT NULL, "modifiers_text" TEXT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "quantity_delta" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(NOT ("quantity_delta" = 0)), "unit_price" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "shifts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "opened_by" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES staff (id), "opened_by_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "opened_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "opening_float" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("opening_float" >= 0), "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "business_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "last_closed_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "shift_closures" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "shift_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES shifts (id), "closed_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "closed_by_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "closed_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "counted_cash" INTEGER NOT NULL, "expected_cash" INTEGER NOT NULL, "variance" INTEGER NOT NULL, "summary_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "carried_open_orders" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "approved_by" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "cash_movements" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "shift_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES shifts (id), "direction" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("amount" > 0), "reason" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_by_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "business_date" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "bills" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "receipt_no" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "receipt_seq" INTEGER NOT NULL, "order_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES orders (id), "operation_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "order_no" INTEGER NOT NULL, "order_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "table_label" TEXT NULL, "customer_name" TEXT NULL, "guest_count" INTEGER NULL, "business_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "local_hour" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "staff_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "staff_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "shift_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES shifts (id), "item_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "items_gross_entered" INTEGER NOT NULL, "discount_entered_total" INTEGER NOT NULL, "items_gross_ex" INTEGER NOT NULL, "items_discount_ex" INTEGER NOT NULL, "items_net_ex" INTEGER NOT NULL, "charges_net_ex" INTEGER NOT NULL, "tax_total" INTEGER NOT NULL, "subtotal_before_rounding" INTEGER NOT NULL, "rounding_adjustment" INTEGER NOT NULL, "total" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("total" >= 0), "change_total" INTEGER NOT NULL, "discount_reason" TEXT NULL, "discount_approved_by" TEXT NULL, "currency_code" TEXT NOT NULL, "time_zone" TEXT NOT NULL, "restaurant_json" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "bill_lines" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "bill_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES bills (id), "order_line_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES order_lines (id), "item_id" TEXT NULL, "item_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "variant_name" TEXT NULL, "category_id" TEXT NULL, "category_name" TEXT NULL, "modifiers_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "quantity" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("quantity" > 0), "unit_price_entered" INTEGER NOT NULL, "gross_entered" INTEGER NOT NULL, "line_discount_entered" INTEGER NOT NULL, "bill_discount_entered" INTEGER NOT NULL, "gross_ex" INTEGER NOT NULL, "discount_ex" INTEGER NOT NULL, "net_ex" INTEGER NOT NULL, "tax_mode" TEXT NOT NULL, "tax_rate_bps" INTEGER NOT NULL, "tax" INTEGER NOT NULL, "total" INTEGER NOT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "bill_charges" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "bill_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES bills (id), "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "label" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_entered" INTEGER NOT NULL, "net_ex" INTEGER NOT NULL, "tax_mode" TEXT NOT NULL, "tax_rate_bps" INTEGER NOT NULL, "tax" INTEGER NOT NULL, "total" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "bill_tax_components" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "bill_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES bills (id), "bill_line_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES bill_lines (id), "bill_charge_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES bill_charges (id), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "rate_bps" INTEGER NOT NULL, "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "payments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "bill_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES bills (id), "method" TEXT NOT NULL, "applied" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("applied" > 0), "tendered" INTEGER NOT NULL, "change_given" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("change_given" >= 0), "shift_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES shifts (id), "business_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "confirmed_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "confirmed_by_name" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "refunds" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "refund_no" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "bill_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES bills (id), "operation_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "reason" TEXT NOT NULL, "authorized_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "authorized_by_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_by_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "business_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "local_hour" INTEGER NOT NULL, "shift_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES shifts (id), "items_gross_ex" INTEGER NOT NULL, "items_discount_ex" INTEGER NOT NULL, "items_net_ex" INTEGER NOT NULL, "charges_net_ex" INTEGER NOT NULL, "tax_total" INTEGER NOT NULL, "rounding_adjustment" INTEGER NOT NULL, "total" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("total" > 0), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "refund_lines" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "refund_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES refunds (id), "bill_line_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES bill_lines (id), "quantity" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("quantity" > 0), "gross_ex" INTEGER NOT NULL, "discount_ex" INTEGER NOT NULL, "net_ex" INTEGER NOT NULL, "tax" INTEGER NOT NULL, "total" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "refund_charges" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "refund_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES refunds (id), "bill_charge_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES bill_charges (id), "net_ex" INTEGER NOT NULL, "tax" INTEGER NOT NULL, "total" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "refund_tax_components" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "refund_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES refunds (id), "source_component_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES bill_tax_components (id), "refund_line_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES refund_lines (id), "refund_charge_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES refund_charges (id), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "rate_bps" INTEGER NOT NULL, "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "refund_payments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "refund_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES refunds (id), "method" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("amount" > 0), "shift_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES shifts (id), "business_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "expenses" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "category" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("amount" > 0), "note" TEXT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_by_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "business_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "paid_from_drawer" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("paid_from_drawer" IN (0, 1)), "shift_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES shifts (id), "voided_at" INTEGER NULL, "voided_by" TEXT NULL, "void_reason" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "printer_profiles" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "role" TEXT NOT NULL, "paper_width_mm" INTEGER NOT NULL, "dots_width" INTEGER NOT NULL, "chars_per_line" INTEGER NOT NULL, "code_page" TEXT NOT NULL, "render_mode" TEXT NOT NULL, "cutter" TEXT NOT NULL, "drawer_pulse" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("drawer_pulse" IN (0, 1)), "transport" TEXT NOT NULL, "endpoint" TEXT NOT NULL, "port" INTEGER NULL, "timeout_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 8000, "feed_lines" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 3, "enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("enabled" IN (0, 1)), "archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("archived" IN (0, 1)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "print_jobs" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "printer_profile_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES printer_profiles (id), "document_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "document_ref" TEXT NULL, "payload_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "copy_label" TEXT NULL, "state" TEXT NOT NULL, "attempt_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "last_error" TEXT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "print_attempts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "job_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES print_jobs (id), "started_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "finished_at" INTEGER NULL, "outcome" TEXT NULL, "error" TEXT NULL, "byte_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "audit_events" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "actor_id" TEXT NULL, "actor_name" TEXT NULL, "action" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_type" TEXT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NULL, "details_json" TEXT NULL, "approved_by" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "completed_operations" ("operation_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "result_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("operation_key"));
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX staff_email ON staff (email)

CREATE INDEX refund_lines_bill_line ON refund_lines (bill_line_id)
CREATE INDEX refund_charges_refund ON refund_charges (refund_id)
CREATE INDEX refund_tax_components_refund ON refund_tax_components (refund_id)
CREATE INDEX refund_payments_refund ON refund_payments (refund_id)
CREATE INDEX refund_payments_date_method ON refund_payments (business_date, method)
CREATE INDEX expenses_business_date ON expenses (business_date)
CREATE INDEX expenses_shift ON expenses (shift_id)
